text_en: In recent years, the growing popularity of online learning has aroused widespread concern among parents and educators alike.
text_cn: 近年来，在线学习的日益流行引起了家长和教育工作者同样的广泛关注。
note: 亮点：arouse widespread concern 引出热议，alike 收尾显平衡；可仿写：只替换现象主语，后半句结构不动。

text_en: It is no exaggeration to say that the way we communicate has been reshaped by social media within a single decade.
text_cn: 毫不夸张地说，我们交流的方式在短短十年间已被社交媒体重塑。
note: 亮点：no exaggeration to say that 语气克制有分量；可仿写：后接被动句陈述变化，避免主观。

text_en: Nowadays, few issues are more hotly debated than whether college students should take part-time jobs during their spare time.
text_cn: 如今，很少有话题比“大学生是否该在课余时间做兼职”争论得更激烈。
note: 亮点：few issues are more hotly debated than 用比较级制造强调；可仿写：whether 从句换成任一有争议的话题。

text_en: With the approach of the digital age, an increasing number of young people prefer reading on screens to reading printed books.
text_cn: 随着数字时代的到来，越来越多的年轻人更愿意在屏幕上阅读，而不是读纸质书。
note: 亮点：With the approach of 铺垫背景，prefer A to B 对比鲜明；可仿写：把阅读换成任一生活习惯，主句保持单数谓语。

text_en: There is a growing awareness that mental health deserves as much attention as physical fitness, especially among students facing academic pressure.
text_cn: 人们日益意识到，心理健康与身体健康同样值得重视，对承受学业压力的学生而言尤其如此。
note: 亮点：There is a growing awareness that 引出共识，as much as 表并列；可仿写：换主题词后可直接用作段首句。

text_en: When it comes to choosing a career, most graduates weigh salary against personal interest, and their final decision often surprises their parents.
text_cn: 谈到择业，多数毕业生会在薪资与个人兴趣之间权衡，而他们最终的选择常令父母意外。
note: 亮点：When it comes to 自然切入话题，weigh A against B 显权衡；可仿写：and 之后换成具体结果，形成反差。

text_en: A recent survey of college students reveals that nearly two-thirds of them spend over three hours a day on short videos.
text_cn: 一项针对大学生的最新调查显示，近三分之二的人每天花三个多小时刷短视频。
note: 亮点：A recent survey reveals that 用调查数据开头，可信度高；可仿写：替换比例与行为，用于现象段首句。

text_en: It is widely acknowledged that reading classics broadens our horizons, yet few of us can spare an hour a week for serious books.
text_cn: 人们普遍承认阅读经典能开阔视野，然而我们中很少有人能每周抽出一小时读严肃书籍。
note: 亮点：It is widely acknowledged that 先立共识，yet 一转形成张力；可仿写：用于共识与反差并存的开头。

text_en: More and more parents are sending their children to after-school classes, a trend that has both supporters and critics in equal measure.
text_cn: 越来越多的家长把孩子送进课外班，这一趋势的支持者与批评者几乎势均力敌。
note: 亮点：逗号后 a trend that 作同位语补充说明，结构高级；可仿写：任何社会现象后都可接 a trend that。

text_en: Whether we like it or not, artificial intelligence is quietly changing the way we study, work and even think about ourselves.
text_cn: 无论我们是否愿意，人工智能都在悄然改变我们学习、工作乃至认识自己的方式。
note: 亮点：Whether we like it or not 使语气客观，the way 后省略 that；可仿写：接任一热点技术或社会趋势。

text_en: What is more important, however, is not how much time we spend online but how wisely we use that time.
text_cn: 然而更重要的是，我们花多少时间上网并不关键，关键在于是否用得明智。
note: 亮点：What is more important is not A but B 递进兼对比；可仿写：放在第二段首句，把话题引向核心论点。

text_en: This phenomenon can be explained from two angles: one is the pressure of competition, and the other is the influence of peers.
text_cn: 这一现象可以从两个方面解释：一是竞争压力，二是同伴影响。
note: 亮点：be explained from two angles 搭分述框架；可仿写：冒号后用 one is ... the other is ... 讲原因。

text_en: Take the students in my dormitory as an example: those who plan their week in advance always finish their papers ahead of the deadline.
text_cn: 以我宿舍的同学为例：提前规划一周的人总能在截止日期前完成论文。
note: 亮点：Take ... as an example 引出例证，ahead of the deadline 具体可感；可仿写：例子要落到能验证的细节。

text_en: Admittedly, part-time jobs may distract students from their studies; nevertheless, they teach young people how to manage time and money.
text_cn: 诚然，兼职可能让学生分心于学业；但它也教会年轻人如何管理时间与金钱。
note: 亮点：Admittedly ... nevertheless ... 先让步后转折，论证稳妥；可仿写：两处各填一个观点，保持正反平衡。

text_en: Behind this change lies a simple truth: convenience, once enjoyed, is hard to give up, especially for a generation raised on smartphones.
text_cn: 这一变化的背后有一个简单的道理：便利一旦享受过便难以舍弃，对在智能手机中长大的一代尤其如此。
note: 亮点：Behind this change lies ... 为完全倒装，主语后置更有分量；可仿写：更换 change 与 truth 后的内容。

text_en: In other words, what separates successful learners from the rest is not talent but the habit of reviewing what they have learned.
text_cn: 换言之，把成功的学习者与其他人区分开的不是天赋，而是复习已学内容的习惯。
note: 亮点：what 引导主语从句，not ... but ... 点明对比；可仿写：用于段中小结或承上启下，句式可直接套用。

text_en: It is precisely because of this that many companies now value teamwork more than individual brilliance when they hire fresh graduates.
text_cn: 正因如此，许多公司在招聘应届毕业生时更看重团队合作，而非个人才华。
note: 亮点：It is precisely because of this that 为强调句，承上又启下；可仿写：precisely 一词让因果关系更确定。

text_en: Compared with their parents, today's graduates face a tougher job market, but they also enjoy far more choices than ever before.
text_cn: 与父辈相比，如今的毕业生面临更严峻的就业市场，但他们也拥有前所未有的更多选择。
note: 亮点：Compared with 引出对比，but 与 far more 平衡两面；可仿写：对比对象与后半句结论均可替换。

text_en: In my view, the value of a university education lies not in the diploma it grants but in the way it trains us to think.
text_cn: 在我看来，大学教育的价值不在于它授予的文凭，而在于它训练我们思考的方式。
note: 亮点：lies not in ... but in ... 亮明立场且结构对称；可仿写：把 education 换成任一事物来表达价值判断。

text_en: Nothing illustrates this point better than the fact that students who keep a reading habit write far more convincing essays than those who do not.
text_cn: 最能说明这一点的，是保持阅读习惯的学生写出的文章远比不阅读的学生有说服力。
note: 亮点：用比较级强行引出例证，气势足；可仿写：后接 the fact that 加一个具体事实。

text_en: If we continue to judge students solely by their test scores, we may well lose the very creativity that the future demands.
text_cn: 如果我们仍仅凭考试分数评判学生，很可能失去未来恰恰需要的创造力。
note: 亮点：条件句推演后果，the very creativity 加强语气；可仿写：把评判标准与代价换成任一论题的两端。

text_en: Those who argue that online courses are less effective often ignore the fact that learners can pause and replay a difficult lecture.
text_cn: 认为网课效果较差的人常常忽略一点：学习者可以暂停并重听难懂的课程。
note: 亮点：Those who argue that ... often ignore the fact that 先树靶再补事实；可仿写：用来礼貌反驳对立观点。

text_en: It is not that young people lack patience; rather, they have grown up in an environment where everything arrives at a single tap.
text_cn: 并非年轻人缺乏耐心，而是他们成长于一个轻点屏幕便能得到一切的环境。
note: 亮点：It is not that ... rather ... 先澄清误解再给真因；可仿写：两个分句各填一种常见误解与实情。

text_en: A case in point is voluntary work in rural schools, which not only helps children there but also teaches volunteers what textbooks cannot.
text_cn: 一个恰当的例子是乡村支教，它不仅帮助了当地孩子，也教给志愿者课本之外的东西。
note: 亮点：A case in point is 精准举例，not only ... but also 双向收益；可仿写：例子后补 which 从句说明意义。

text_en: Only when students are allowed to make their own choices can they learn to take responsibility for the consequences.
text_cn: 只有让学生自己做选择，他们才能学会为后果承担责任。
note: 亮点：Only when 置于句首引起部分倒装，语气坚定；可仿写：主句换成任一教育目的或成长目标。

text_en: The benefits of physical exercise go far beyond a slimmer figure: regular training sharpens memory, lifts mood and builds the resilience we need in exams.
text_cn: 体育锻炼的好处远不止身材变好：规律训练能提高记忆力、改善情绪，并培养考试所需的韧性。
note: 亮点：go far beyond 拓展论点，冒号后三项并列撑起论证；可仿写：三项用动词开头，保持结构整齐。

text_en: As the chart shows, the percentage of students reading paper books dropped from 60% in 2015 to 35% in 2023.
text_cn: 如图所示，阅读纸质书的学生比例从 2015 年的 60% 降至 2023 年的 35%。
note: 亮点：the percentage of ... dropped from ... to ... 是描述趋势的样板；可仿写：换对象与年份，注意介词搭配。

text_en: By contrast, the figure for those who study online rose sharply, nearly tripling from 12% to 34% within the same period.
text_cn: 相比之下，在线学习者的比例大幅上升，同期从 12% 升至 34%，几乎增至三倍。
note: 亮点：By contrast 对比两组数据，nearly tripling 用分词补倍数；可仿写：倍数词随数据换成 doubling 等。

text_en: The figures reveal a steady upward trend: the number of volunteers in our city climbed from 5,000 to 18,000 over the past five years.
text_cn: 数据呈现出稳步上升的趋势：过去五年，我市志愿者人数从 5000 人增至 18000 人。
note: 亮点：reveal a steady upward trend 先概括走势，冒号后给数字；可仿写：先总后分，是图表段的稳妥写法。

text_en: What stands out in the table is that rural students spend nearly twice as much time on housework as their urban peers.
text_cn: 表中格外引人注意的是，农村学生做家务的时间几乎是城市同龄人的两倍。
note: 亮点：What stands out is that 突出关键数据，twice as much as 表倍数；可仿写：用于图表最显著的一点。

text_en: While the number of library visitors fell by half, borrowing figures remained stable, which suggests that readers simply moved online rather than losing interest.
text_cn: 图书馆到访人数减半，但借阅量保持稳定，这说明读者只是转向线上，而非失去兴趣。
note: 亮点：While 对比两组数据，which suggests that 由数据推结论；可仿写：结论句不要重复数字，要给出判断。

text_en: According to the survey, only one in five graduates would accept a job unrelated to their major, a share far lower than ten years ago.
text_cn: 调查显示，只有五分之一的毕业生愿意接受与专业无关的工作，这一比例远低于十年前。
note: 亮点：one in five 表比例，a share far lower than 复指数据再比较；可仿写：适合描述偏低或偏小的数据。

text_en: In conclusion, only by balancing study and rest can we keep our minds sharp throughout four years of college.
text_cn: 总之，只有平衡学习与休息，我们才能在四年大学里始终保持头脑敏锐。
note: 亮点：In conclusion 收束全文，only by 置句首用倒装强调方法；可仿写：主句写清这样做的预期结果。

text_en: To sum up, the key to solving this problem lies in a joint effort by schools, families and students themselves rather than in any single measure.
text_cn: 总而言之，解决这一问题的关键在于学校、家庭与学生本人的共同努力，而非任何单一措施。
note: 亮点：the key lies in ... rather than in ... 给方案又排偏方；可仿写：三方并列用 by 引出，收尾更完整。

text_en: It is high time that we stopped treating rest as a reward and started regarding it as part of serious study.
text_cn: 我们该停止把休息当作奖励，转而把它视为认真学习的一部分了。
note: 亮点：It is high time that 后接过去式表虚拟，呼吁有力；可仿写：两个动词并列写态度转变，避免空喊。

text_en: Therefore, I would suggest that every freshman set aside thirty minutes a day for reading, however busy the schedule may be.
text_cn: 因此，我建议每位大一学生每天留出三十分钟阅读，无论日程多忙。
note: 亮点：I would suggest that 后接动词原形，however busy 表让步；可仿写：建议要具体到时间与动作才可信。

text_en: Only in this way can the gap between what we learn in class and what the workplace needs be narrowed in the years to come.
text_cn: 只有这样，课堂所学与职场需求之间的差距才能在未来几年逐步缩小。
note: 亮点：Only in this way 引导倒装，两个 what 从句作并列成分；可仿写：主句用被动语态更显正式。

text_en: If each of us takes one small step, the campus will gradually become a place where waste is rare and courtesy is common.
text_cn: 若我们每个人都迈出一小步，校园将逐渐成为一个浪费少见、礼让常见的地方。
note: 亮点：条件句收尾，where 从句用 rare 与 common 对比写理想状态；可仿写：结尾两词对照，画面感更强。

text_en: As long as we treat technology as a tool rather than a master, we have every reason to look forward to a brighter future.
text_cn: 只要我们视技术为工具而非主人，就完全有理由期待更光明的未来。
note: 亮点：As long as 提出前提，rather than 划清态度；可仿写：结尾用 every reason to 表达谨慎乐观。

text_en: Whatever path we take after graduation, the habit of asking why will serve us better than the ability to memorize answers.
text_cn: 无论毕业后走哪条路，追问“为什么”的习惯都会比死记答案的能力更有用。
note: 亮点：Whatever 引导让步状语，serve sb. better than 作比较收尾；可仿写：以习惯对比能力，避免口号式结尾。
